Interface ContextPool

public interface ContextPool
Context pool manages contexts of all plugins.

A plugin registers its contexts in its constructor and obtains contexts of other (connected) plugins in Plugin.initialize().

  • Method Details

    • register

      void register(long pluginID, Context context, Class<? extends Context> contextInterface)
      Register plugin context.

      Context interface is the "key" under which the context object is registered. Lookup is by exact interface, so memory and device contexts should be registered also under MemoryContext or DeviceContext. Contexts registered under the same interface (by any plugin) are indexed from 0 in registration order.

      Parameters:
      pluginID - owner plugin ID
      context - the context object
      contextInterface - context interface implemented by the context object
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if contextInterface is not an interface or context does not implement it
      IllegalStateException - if the context is already registered

    • unregister

      boolean unregister(long pluginID, Class<? extends Context> contextInterface)
      Unregisters all contexts of the plugin registered under given context interface.
      Parameters:

      contextInterface - context interface
      Returns:
      true if contexts were unregistered, false if there was nothing to unregister
